Sarah & Stone

Founded by two friends with a shared love for fashion and mindful design, Sarah & Stone is a celebration of effortless beauty and sustainable values.

Inspired by coastal calm and natural textures, our bags & accessories are designed to feel timeless, functional, and a little bit free-spirited.
